scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && cd ai_service && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "front,back,ai,browser" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow,blue" "npm run dev --prefix frontend -- -p 3000" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "cd ai_service && python app.py" "timeout /t 5 && start http://localhost:3000"
